title: I really thought about the previous feedback and tried my best to fix it. What do you think? I'd appreciate your opinions.
author: Most_Industry8958
selftext:
I received a lot of feedback on the game([Return to Lumia](https://store.steampowered.com/app/4696030/Return_to_Lumia/)), so I tried to fix it as much as possible. Please take a look and give me your thoughts.

I used AI for the graphics, sound, and code, and I handled the planning and system design parts myself.

comments.author: Mysterious-Sea5646
comments.body: like in fights or so, make him have a serious face

replies.author: DrinkCubaLibre
replies.body: I thought the static smile was hilarious and psychotic looking

comments.author: egod
comments.body: Can you show a full gameplay video?

replies.author: Most_Industry8958
replies.body:
I am currently working on actual gameplay footage to upload to Steam, but I don't think I'll be able to share it right away.

I will share it once production is complete.

comments.author: Agreeable-Safety-360
comments.body: What did you do for animating the sprites? And how did you keep visual consistency with all your ai assets? How long did it take to achieve that consistency?

replies.author: Most_Industry8958
replies.body:
I created the base images using GPT. However, once all the images were finished, I handed them over to GPT at once and asked them to ensure artistic consistency.

There were a few trial-and-error attempts, but I think it turned out fairly consistent.

Also, regarding the sprites, I previously created their animations one by one using GPT, but after recently discovering AetherForgeai, I am remaking the animations entirely using it (the bosses in the video use animations created with AetherForgeai).
